description: order.py writes its own, separate ledger (~/loops/earn-pm-trade/orders.jsonl, order.py:74-79) that shares NO key (no window_end_ms, no trade-id) with decide.py's paper-positions.jsonl (decide.py:177-182). Worse, decide.py hardcodes `"mode": "paper"` on every recorded row (decide.py:178) with no awareness of whether EARN_MODE=execute actually fired a real order for that same decision via run.sh/order.py. Consequence: once real execution is live, gate.py's PM_PAPER_PASS computation (gate.py:_load_resolved, filters only on src=='momentum'/status=='resolved') will keep blending REAL-money outcomes into what it treats as a 'paper' sample with no way to distinguish them, and there is no code path anywhere that reconciles a real order_id against the paper-ledger row it was supposed to correspond to. This is a structural coupling failure between the two effectful shells that the spec (SKILL.md) never calls out.
